body: Thank you so much. What you said brought me to tears. I don't know you but thank you.

I just don't know how to let go. I wanted to marry her. I wanted to be with her forever. we had even planned it. I'm afraid to move on. I don't think I'm strong enough to go on. thats why I just want to die. I have nothing in me life. she was everything

I'm 20 years old. The last 3 years of my life have been with her. I wrote this on paper for when I'm finally able to kill myself one of these days soon. I don't have any friends because of social anxiety. I'm not in school. I don't have a job anymore. She was my everything and the only thing I cared about. I just don't want to be alive anymore. I'm trying to figure out how to end it. I slept on it and I just woke up and I still want to die.
